$comment: Advisories accepted on purpose, each with a reason and a date to look again.
Read by tools/audit-allowlist.mjs. Anything NOT listed here still fails the
gate at high or critical. An entry here stops being an exception the moment
a real fix ships or its reviewBy date passes — the checker fails in both
cases, so an accepted risk cannot quietly become a permanent one.
Do not add an entry to make a build green. Add one when the honest answer is
'there is no fix and the exposure is understood', and write down why.

accepted.title: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
reason: No fixed version exists. The advisory covers image-size <=2.0.2, which is
every published release; npm reports fixAvailable as a DOWNGRADE of the
parent to pptxgenjs@1.1.5 — three majors below the pinned ^4.0.1, and
'clean' only because pptxgenjs v1 predates the image-size dependency
entirely. Taking it would break scripts/generate-pptx.mjs to satisfy a
Exposure: image-size is reached only through pptxgenjs, and only via the
single slide.addImage() in scripts/integrate-reveal-slides.mjs, whose data
comes from imageDataUri() reading a committed file off disk. That script
is not in the build chain — it is run by hand. The vulnerability is a DoS
on malformed ICNS/JXL/HEIF input, and no untrusted image reaches it.
Worst case if wrong: a hand-run script hangs, on a machine belonging to
the person who ran it. No student-facing or deployed surface.

accepted.title: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
reason: Same package, same reachability, same absence of a fix as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr
above. Listed separately so that if one is fixed and the other is not, the
gate says so instead of treating them as one decision.
